decisions.summary: SEATING_GROUND_FT = 162, the side of a square holding the pool's mean envelope plus the least wood floor, sizing only _seat_households' lattice and seat bound
decisions.why: FR-010 and the spec's Decisions table settle the figure, its derivation from measured homesteads and its class (a labeled guess).

decisions.summary: The margin's choice, the canvas's room and the belt keep HOMESTEAD_GROUND_FT's 104; maps do not start larger
decisions.why: Unchanged since round 2. The GM's larger-maps line is conditional in its own words ('If the thing that is stopping us ... is the margin in the sense of being the edge of the map'); R12 measured the condition false (the canvas grown alone made 40 households worse) and growing canvas, margin and belt refused sites the base seated (R11), which FR-008 forbids. Implied by the GM's own condition, not by cost.

decisions.summary: D1's FR-011 verdict GO from R15's band-alone leg, back to back with the base
decisions.why: Round 2's item is fixed: R15 runs base (worktree at 8d15b8a27), the band with DRY_SPELL/RESCUE_SHORT disabled (legs.py rebinds the module globals capacity.seat_the_rest reads at call time), and the band with both, one after the other; legs.log matches the table row for row, houses=40 on every rolled seed. A verdict on its own leg is FR-011 as written. Two figures in D1 (and R15) are stated other than measured and must be corrected, neither moving the ruling: (a) '427.7 -> 100.0 s over the fifteen seeds the base rolled' - 100.0 is the sixteen-seed sum including seed 7's 5.00; over the fifteen it is 95.0 (and D2's leg 78.3); (b) 'the first margin on 10 of 16' - legs.log's band leg has rung=1 on 9 of 16 (seeds 1,3,4,5,9,10,11,13,47); with both it is 11 of 16.

decisions.summary: Rescue and dry-spell cap built on R15's third leg on the final D1: 100.0 -> 83.3 s, margins saved on seeds 25, 8 and 6, seed 39 slower, no seed seating fewer
decisions.why: Round 2's item is fixed: the evidence is now the lever on top of the final D1, back to back. The gain is structural rather than timing noise (offers on seed 25 9,911 -> 1,682, seed 8 2,704 -> 1,364; identical-offer seeds differ by ~0.1 s), so faster beyond the spread; every household seated. Building a lever on its own GO is FR-011. Seed 39's cost (7.45 -> 13.96 s) is stated, not hidden.

decisions.summary: FR-003 and FR-004 not built (R1, R3, R4 NO-GO; FR-003's rules-based form argued, not prototyped); seed 47 restated from R15; misses recorded and raised
decisions.why: FR-011 builds no lever without its own GO and FR-002's further rounds were run. Round 2's note is fixed: seed 47 at 2.99 s alone and 3.11 s with D2, first margin, matches legs.log.

decisions.summary: Census armed on _geom primitives, overlap.py predicates and shapely's binary predicates and distance; comparisons in C over arrays not seen
decisions.why: Unchanged since round 2: the remaining limit is real for sys.monitoring, and the engine's vectorized calls are the rasters and boxes the GM's rule asks for, not scans standing in for them.

decisions.summary: CENSUS_FLAG = 5,000, the tail listed down to the bulk
decisions.why: The spec delegates the threshold to the plan from the measured distribution; round 2's note is fixed - R10 now carries 3,859, 2,631, 2,624, 1,857, 1,799 and 1,725 from its run.

decisions.why: FR-006's standing check beside make perf.

decisions.summary: Every check the census flags, starting with R10's nine, gets its index, box or line; identical answers preferred, a moved answer held to FR-008
A check left unchanged only where the fix is slower by the wall clock, recorded with measurement, mechanism and sketch
decisions.why: FR-007 allows 'recorded with the measurement of why not'; a slower index would defeat the request's purpose.

decisions.summary: The planted region's sliver line fixed and tested (R8)

Process under feature 294's occasion table, not a narrowing of the request.
